words.enDefinition: someone doing temporary work to learn about a profession

examples.en: As an intern at the archive, I helped prepare catalog records for a new collection.
examples.zh: 作为档案馆的「实习生」，我帮忙为一批新馆藏编制目录记录。

examples.en: The intern who worked here last summer showed us how she organized her research notes.
examples.zh: 去年夏天在这里工作的那位「实习生」给我们看了她如何整理研究笔记。

words.enDefinition: a student working at an organization as part of a course

examples.en: I worked as a placement student at a UK gallery during my second year.
examples.zh: 第二学年，我以「校方课程实习生」的身份在英国一家美术馆工作。

examples.en: The placement student went back to university after finishing the project with our team.
examples.zh: 这位「校方课程实习生」和我们团队一起完成项目后就返校了。

words.enDefinition: a year of workplace experience within a university course

examples.en: At my UK university, I took a placement year between my second and final years.
examples.zh: 我在英国那所大学读书时，第二学年和最后一学年之间是「实习年」。

examples.en: After my placement year with an engineering firm, I chose a different final project topic.
examples.zh: 在工程公司度过「实习年」后，我给毕业项目换了个题目。

words.zhGloss: 学习与工作交替的合作教育
words.enDefinition: an educational model alternating academic study with supervised work
acceptedZhAnswers: 学习与工作交替的合作教育

examples.en: I chose cooperative education at my Canadian university because I wanted work experience during my degree.
examples.zh: 我在加拿大上大学时选择了「学习与工作交替的合作教育」，想在读书期间积累工作经验。

examples.en: Our cooperative education adviser showed us when we would be back on campus after working.
examples.zh: 「合作教育」顾问给我们看了工作期结束后返校的时间。

words.enDefinition: a period spent working within a cooperative education program

examples.en: During my first co-op term in Canada, I joined a small team at a public library.
examples.zh: 在加拿大的第一个「合作教育工作期」，我加入了公共图书馆的一个小团队。

examples.en: My next co-op term starts in May, so I'll return to lectures in September.
examples.zh: 我的下一个「合作教育工作期」五月开始，所以九月再回来上课。

words.enDefinition: course learning that integrates academic study with work practices

examples.en: My Australian course includes work-integrated learning through a design project with a local charity.
examples.zh: 我在澳大利亚的课程有「工学结合」项目，其中包括和本地慈善机构合作的设计任务。

examples.en: The work-integrated learning elective uses simulated workplace projects alongside regular seminars on campus.
examples.zh: 这门「工学结合」选修课既有模拟职场项目，也有在学校上的常规研讨课。

words.enDefinition: a period of work experience during the summer break

examples.en: My summer internship ended two weeks before my final year of university began.
examples.zh: 我的「暑期实习」在大学最后一学年开始前两周结束。

examples.en: I looked for a summer internship near home because I was staying with family.
examples.zh: 暑假我和家人一起住，所以就在家附近找「暑期实习」。

words.enDefinition: an internship carried out while regular classes are in session

examples.en: I arranged a term-time internship on Fridays, when my course has no scheduled classes.
examples.zh: 我把「学期内实习」安排在周五，那天我的课程没排课。

examples.en: The gallery's term-time internship fits around lectures and runs until the spring break.
examples.zh: 美术馆的「学期内实习」能灵活避开上课时间，一直持续到春假。

words.enDefinition: work experience for which the intern receives pay

examples.en: I picked a paid internship because I would need to cover my own travel costs.
examples.zh: 我选了「有薪实习」，因为得自己负担路费。

examples.en: The museum offers a paid internship for students helping with its summer exhibitions.
examples.zh: 博物馆提供「有薪实习」，招学生帮忙做夏季展览。

collocations: a paid internship at a museum

words.enDefinition: an internship that does not pay a wage

examples.en: I checked whether I could afford to do an unpaid internship during the break.
examples.zh: 我算了算，看看自己能不能负担假期做「无薪实习」的开销。

examples.en: The department listed an unpaid internship at a community radio station near campus.
examples.zh: 院系列了一项「无薪实习」，地点在学校附近的社区电台。

words.enDefinition: an internship that does not earn academic credit

examples.en: I did a non-credit internship because I wanted experience in a different kind of workplace.
examples.zh: 我做了一段「不计学分的实习」，想在另一类工作环境中积累经验。

examples.en: My adviser explained that the non-credit internship wouldn't replace the course I needed to take.
examples.zh: 导师解释说，「不计学分的实习」不能顶替我需要修的那门课。

words.enDefinition: an internship carried out online from a different location

examples.en: My virtual internship involved weekly video meetings with a design team in another city.
examples.zh: 我做「线上实习」时，每周和另一座城市的设计团队开视频会。

examples.en: I chose a virtual internship because I couldn't move away from campus that semester.
examples.zh: 那学期我没法搬离学校，所以选了「线上实习」。

collocations: a virtual internship with a remote team

words.enDefinition: an internship involving work on a research project

examples.en: I spent my research internship comparing how local newspapers reported changes to the bus routes.
examples.zh: 我在「科研实习」期间比较了本地几家报纸是如何报道公交线路变化的。

examples.en: The research internship ended with a short presentation about the records we had reviewed.
examples.zh: 「科研实习」以一场简短的汇报收尾，讲的是我们查过的记录。

words.enDefinition: a supervised period of learning in a clinical setting

examples.en: My clinical placement was based at a hospital, and my tutor checked in each week.
examples.zh: 我的「临床实习」在医院，导师每周都会跟进情况。

examples.en: The university let me know which site would host my second clinical placement.
examples.zh: 学校告诉我第二段「临床实习」由哪个机构接收。

collocations: a clinical placement at a hospital

words.enDefinition: a period of supervised classroom teaching for a trainee teacher

examples.en: During my student teaching placement, I met the class teacher each afternoon to review lessons.
examples.zh: 「教学实习」期间，我每天下午和班上的老师一起回顾当天的课。

examples.en: My student teaching placement was at a school within cycling distance of the university.
examples.zh: 我的「教学实习」在一所离大学不远的学校，可以骑车过去。

collocations: a student teaching placement in a primary school

words.enDefinition: supervised practical training in the setting where a profession is carried out

examples.en: My social work course arranged a field placement with a youth organization near campus.
examples.zh: 我的社会工作课程把「专业现场实习」安排在学校附近的一家青年机构。

examples.en: The field placement gave us a chance to put our classroom discussions into practice.
examples.zh: 「专业现场实习」让我们有机会把课堂上讨论的内容用到实际工作里。

words.enDefinition: a project supported with money or resources by an employer or industry group

examples.en: Our industry-sponsored project used sample data supplied by a local transport company during the placement.
examples.zh: 实习期间，我们的「业界资助项目」用到了本地一家运输公司提供的样本数据。

examples.en: I joined an industry-sponsored project because I wanted to see how clients set their priorities.
examples.zh: 我加入了一个「业界资助项目」，想看看客户怎样给各项需求排序。

collocations: take part in an industry-sponsored project

words.enDefinition: a piece of work assigned to someone during an internship

examples.en: My internship project was to map the public routes between the museum and its storehouse.
examples.zh: 我的「实习项目」是绘制博物馆和库房之间公众可走的路线图。

examples.en: The team reviewed my internship project in a short meeting during my last week.
examples.zh: 实习最后一周，团队开了个短会，评审了我的「实习项目」。

words.enDefinition: a group of interns who start a program together

examples.en: Everyone in my internship cohort worked at a different branch of the same library service.
examples.zh: 和我「同批实习的同学」都在同一个图书馆系统的不同分馆工作。

examples.en: The internship cohort met on Fridays to compare what we'd learned that week.
examples.zh: 「同批实习生」每周五碰面，交流一周里各自学到了什么。

words.enDefinition: practical training in an occupation through supervised work and study

examples.en: My cousin chose an apprenticeship to learn how to maintain the equipment at a studio.
examples.zh: 我表弟选择参加「学徒培训」，学习怎么维护工作室的设备。

examples.en: The apprenticeship included study time as well as work next to experienced technicians.
examples.zh: 「学徒培训」既安排了学习时间，也安排了跟有经验的技术员一起工作的时间。

words.enDefinition: an apprenticeship combining a job with study towards a degree

examples.en: I heard about a degree apprenticeship at a careers event in England last term.
examples.zh: 上学期我在英格兰的一场就业活动上听说了一个「学位学徒制项目」。

examples.en: She chose a degree apprenticeship because she wanted to study engineering while working in industry.
examples.zh: 她选了「学位学徒制项目」，想一边在行业里工作，一边读工程专业。

words.enDefinition: an employee being trained to take on management responsibilities

examples.en: The management trainee spent her first rotation learning how the depot planned its daily deliveries.
examples.zh: 这位「管理培训生」在第一轮轮岗中学习了配送中心怎么安排每天的送货。

examples.en: I met a management trainee who had recently moved from customer service into operations.
examples.zh: 我遇到了一位「管理培训生」，刚从客服轮岗到运营部门。

words.enDefinition: a structured employer program for people who recently finished university

examples.en: The UK graduate scheme lets new graduates work with several teams before choosing an area.
examples.zh: 这个英国的「毕业生培养项目」让刚毕业的人先在几个团队工作，再选方向。

examples.en: I compared the training on each graduate scheme before deciding which ones to apply for.
examples.zh: 我比较了各个「毕业生培养项目」的培训内容，才决定申请哪些。

words.enDefinition: a recent graduate employed in a formal training role

examples.en: I joined the museum as a graduate trainee and spent a month with its exhibitions team.
examples.zh: 我以「毕业生培训生」的身份进了博物馆，在展览团队工作了一个月。

examples.en: The graduate trainee met her supervisor to discuss what she would learn next month.
examples.zh: 这位「毕业生培训生」和导师见了面，讨论下个月要学什么。

words.enDefinition: the organization providing a place for a student to train

examples.en: The host organization sent us directions because the entrance is shared with another office.
examples.zh: 「实习接收单位」给我们发了路线说明，因为入口和另一家单位共用。

examples.en: I needed the name of my host organization before the school could complete its paperwork.
examples.zh: 学校要先拿到「实习接收单位」的名称，才能把手续办完。

collocations: agree terms with a host organization

words.enDefinition: the person who arranges and coordinates training placements

examples.en: The placement coordinator helped me compare two sites with very different commuting times.
examples.zh: 「实习协调员」帮我比较了两家通勤时间差很多的实习单位。

examples.en: I told the placement coordinator when my seminar moved to our usual placement day.
examples.zh: 研讨课改到平时实习那天后，我告诉了「实习协调员」。

words.enDefinition: the person overseeing a student's day-to-day work on placement

examples.en: My placement supervisor checked my progress each Friday and suggested a task for the following week.
examples.zh: 「实习带教人员」每周五检查我的进展，并建议下周做一项什么任务。

examples.en: I asked my placement supervisor whether I could sit in on the team's planning meeting.
examples.zh: 我问「实习带教人员」自己能不能旁听团队的计划会议。

words.enDefinition: a faculty member overseeing the academic side of a placement

examples.en: My faculty supervisor checked that the internship project connected with what I was studying.
examples.zh: 「校方实习指导老师」确认了实习项目和我学的内容有关。

examples.en: I sent the draft reflection to my faculty supervisor before discussing it at the college.
examples.zh: 我先把反思初稿发给「校方实习指导老师」，再回学院讨论。

words.enDefinition: a practitioner who guides a learner during a clinical placement

examples.en: My clinical preceptor in Canada met me at reception and showed me the team's office.
examples.zh: 我在加拿大的「临床实习带教老师」在前台接我，带我看了团队的办公室。

examples.en: The clinical preceptor set aside time to talk about what I had learned that week.
examples.zh: 「临床实习带教老师」专门留了点时间，和我聊这一周学到了什么。

words.enDefinition: an experienced colleague who gives informal guidance at work

examples.en: My workplace mentor helped me think about which teams I might want to try next.
examples.zh: 「职场导师」帮我考虑接下来可以去哪些团队试试。

examples.en: I met my workplace mentor once a month to talk about skills I'd like to develop.
examples.zh: 我每月和「职场导师」见一次面，聊聊想培养的技能。

collocations: get advice from a workplace mentor

words.enDefinition: a student who alternates academic study with work placements

examples.en: As a co-op student in Canada, I returned to classes after working at the archive.
examples.zh: 在加拿大作为「参加合作教育的学生」，我在档案馆工作一段时间后就回去上课了。

examples.en: The library hired a co-op student to help its publications team during the work term.
examples.zh: 图书馆招了一位「参加合作教育的学生」，在工作期内协助出版团队。

words.enDefinition: an organization that delivers the formal instruction for a training program

examples.en: The employer put me in touch with the training provider that ran the study sessions.
examples.zh: 雇主帮我联系了组织学习课程的「培训机构」。

examples.en: I asked the training provider how its classes would fit around my shifts.
examples.zh: 我问「培训机构」他们的课怎么安排，能避开我的班次。

words.enDefinition: a placement that earns academic credit as part of a course

examples.en: I chose a credit-bearing placement at the museum to connect my work experience with coursework.
examples.zh: 我选了博物馆的「计学分的实习」，把工作经验和课程学习结合起来。

examples.en: The course handbook calls it a credit-bearing placement and gives the deadline for the report.
examples.zh: 课程手册把这项实践称为「计学分的实习」，也注明了报告的截止日期。

words.enDefinition: an agreement setting out what a student will learn and how

examples.en: We wrote a learning agreement covering the skills I wanted to develop at the archive.
examples.zh: 我们写了份「学习协议」，列出了我想在档案馆培养的技能。

examples.en: My supervisor and I revised the learning agreement once I had chosen a project.
examples.zh: 选好项目后，我和带教老师修改了「学习协议」。

words.enDefinition: the agreed limits of the student's activities during a placement

examples.en: I asked my supervisor to clarify the placement scope before I agreed to extra tasks.
examples.zh: 答应做额外任务前，我请带教老师明确「实习工作范围」。

examples.en: The placement scope covered maintaining the exhibition records and helping with scheduled public events.
examples.zh: 「实习工作范围」包括维护展览记录和协助已安排的公众活动。

words.enDefinition: a placement the student finds and arranges independently

examples.en: My self-arranged placement came from a conversation with a manager at the local arts centre.
examples.zh: 和本地艺术中心一位经理聊过后，我找到了这份「自行联系的实习」。

examples.en: I sent the course office the dates and contact details for my self-arranged placement.
examples.zh: 我把「自行联系的实习」的日期和联系方式发给了课程办公室。

words.enDefinition: a placement found and organized by the university

examples.en: I chose a university-arranged placement because I was new to the city and its employers.
examples.zh: 我刚到这座城市，不熟悉当地的用人单位，所以选择了「学校安排的实习」。

examples.en: The university-arranged placement was close to campus, which made the weekly meetings easier to attend.
examples.zh: 「学校安排的实习」离学校近，每周的会议更容易参加。

words.enDefinition: the process of matching students to suitable host organizations

examples.en: The placement matching process took my interests and the bus routes into account.
examples.zh: 「实习匹配」过程考虑了我的兴趣和公交线路。

examples.en: We supplied our preferred dates before the placement matching started for the summer period.
examples.zh: 暑期「实习匹配」开始前，我们提交了自己更希望实习的日期。

words.enDefinition: a student's preferred site or type of placement

examples.en: My placement preference was a small museum where I could work with collection records.
examples.zh: 我的「实习志愿」是一家小博物馆，能做馆藏记录方面的工作。

examples.en: I changed my placement preference after finding out how early the trains started running.
examples.zh: 弄清最早几点有火车后，我调整了「实习志愿」。

words.enDefinition: the specific placement assigned to a student

examples.en: I checked my placement allocation and found that the site was on a direct bus route.
examples.zh: 我查了「实习分配结果」，发现有公交直达实习地点。

examples.en: The placement allocation sent on Friday listed the host and the name of my supervisor.
examples.zh: 周五发来的「实习分配结果」列出了接收单位和带教老师的名字。

words.enDefinition: a schedule listing the shifts a student will work during placement

examples.en: During my placement at a UK hospital, I checked the placement rota before arranging travel.
examples.zh: 在英国一家医院实习时，我先查了「实习轮班表」，再安排出行。

examples.en: The placement rota changed when two students needed to attend a seminar on Friday.
examples.zh: 两名学生周五要参加研讨课，所以「实习轮班表」调整了。

words.enDefinition: the days on which a placement starts and ends

examples.en: I compared my placement dates with the exam timetable before signing the department's form.
examples.zh: 签院系的表格前，我对照了「实习起止日期」和考试时间表。

examples.en: The host asked whether our placement dates could shift by a week in June.
examples.zh: 接收单位问，我们在六月的「实习起止日期」能不能挪一周。

words.enDefinition: a period set aside for a continuous run of placement days

examples.en: The summer placement block runs for four weeks without any classes scheduled on campus.
examples.zh: 暑期的「连续实习时段」为四周，期间学校没有排课。

examples.en: I found short-term accommodation near the school for the duration of my placement block.
examples.zh: 我在那所学校附近找了个短期住处，打算住完整个「连续实习时段」。

words.enDefinition: the smallest amount of placement time that must be completed

examples.en: The course handbook lists the minimum placement hours for each of our training modules.
examples.zh: 课程手册列出了每个培训单元的「最低实习时数」。

examples.en: I asked if the revised timetable would let me meet the minimum placement hours.
examples.zh: 我问改过的时间表能不能让我达到「最低实习时数」。

words.enDefinition: a record of the time a student spends on placement

examples.en: I updated the placement hours log after each visit instead of waiting until Friday.
examples.zh: 我每次实习结束后都更新「实习工时记录表」，不等到周五。

examples.en: The tutor used my placement hours log to check which days I'd been there.
examples.zh: 导师用我的「实习工时记录表」核对我在哪几天到岗。

words.enDefinition: officially approve the time that a student recorded on placement

examples.en: My supervisor agreed to sign off on placement hours before she left for the break.
examples.zh: 带教老师同意放假离开前「审核确认实习时数」。

examples.en: I asked who could sign off on placement hours when the usual supervisor was absent.
examples.zh: 我问平时的带教老师不在时，谁可以「审核确认实习时数」。

collocations: ask someone to sign off on placement hours
a supervisor can sign off on placement hours
sign off on placement hours at the end

words.enDefinition: additional hours worked to replace required time you missed

examples.en: I arranged make-up hours at the library after missing two sessions during the term.
examples.zh: 学期里有两次没去实习，我安排在图书馆把「要补的实习时数」做完。

examples.en: The tutor showed me how to record my make-up hours separately from the regular sessions.
examples.zh: 导师告诉我，怎么把「补做的实习时数」和常规实习分开记录。

words.zhGloss: 校方导师到实习点探访
words.enDefinition: a visit by a course tutor to check how a placement is going
acceptedZhAnswers: 校方导师到实习点探访

examples.en: My school tutor arranged a placement visit to meet the team at the archive.
examples.zh: 学校导师安排了「到实习点探访」，和档案馆的团队见面。

examples.en: The tutor asked what I wanted to discuss during the placement visit on Thursday.
examples.zh: 学校导师问我，周四「到实习点探访」时我想讨论些什么。

words.enDefinition: a short session explaining arrangements before a placement begins

examples.en: At the pre-placement briefing, the tutor explained what to do if the host changed our hours.
examples.zh: 在「实习前说明会」上，导师讲了如果接收单位调整工时，该怎么处理。

examples.en: I took notes at the pre-placement briefing about who to contact during the summer.
examples.zh: 我在「实习前说明会」记下了暑期该联系哪些人。

collocations: take notes at a pre-placement briefing

words.enDefinition: a guide to how a course or program runs placements

examples.en: I consulted the placement handbook when I couldn't remember who would mark the report.
examples.zh: 我记不清谁会给报告评分，就查了「实习手册」。

examples.en: The placement handbook had a checklist for students who were changing their training site.
examples.zh: 「实习手册」里有一张清单，供更换实习地点的同学使用。

words.enDefinition: costs someone incurs while taking part in a placement

examples.en: My placement expenses increased when the training site moved farther away from campus.
examples.zh: 实习地点搬到离学校更远的地方后，我的「实习开支」增加了。

examples.en: I saved the train receipts because the course office wanted a record of placement expenses.
examples.zh: 课程办公室要「实习开支」的记录，所以我留了火车票收据。

words.enDefinition: the standards used to judge a student's performance on placement

examples.en: We discussed the placement assessment criteria before my supervisor watched me present the project.
examples.zh: 带教老师看我的项目汇报之前，我们讨论了「实习评估标准」。

examples.en: The placement assessment criteria included how clearly we recorded decisions in our weekly notes.
examples.zh: 「实习评估标准」包括能否在每周记录里把作过的决定写清楚。

words.enDefinition: the skills or knowledge a particular person needs to develop

examples.en: We discussed individual learning needs before assigning different tasks to the students on placement.
examples.zh: 给各位实习生分配不同任务前，我们讨论了他们的「个人学习需求」。

examples.en: My mentor considered my individual learning needs when selecting a project for the second rotation.
examples.zh: 导师给第二轮轮岗选项目时，考虑了我的「个人学习需求」。

collocations: adapt training to individual learning needs

words.enDefinition: an agreement about how someone will be guided and supported

examples.en: Our supervision agreement set out how often my workplace tutor and I would meet.
examples.zh: 「带教安排协议」写明了我和单位的带教老师多久见一次面。

examples.en: I reread the supervision agreement after my usual contact moved to another team.
examples.zh: 平时联系的人调去另一个团队后，我重读了「带教安排协议」。

words.enDefinition: a written account of what a student did and learned on placement

examples.en: I explained how the exhibition changed over the summer in my placement report.
examples.zh: 我在「实习报告」里说明了展览在暑期是怎么调整的。

examples.en: The tutor read my placement report before asking what I would do differently next time.
examples.zh: 导师先读了我的「实习报告」，再问我下次会有哪些不同做法。

words.enDefinition: a regular record of what you learn from your experiences

examples.en: I kept a reflective journal to record what surprised me each week at the archive.
examples.zh: 我写「反思日志」，记下每周在档案馆遇到的意外发现。

examples.en: My reflective journal helped me remember why I changed my approach halfway through the placement.
examples.zh: 「反思日志」帮我想起实习中途为什么换了做法。

words.enDefinition: an arrangement that lets a placement continue beyond its original end date

examples.en: I requested a placement extension so I could finish cataloging the last set of photographs.
examples.zh: 我申请「延长实习期」，好编完最后一组照片的目录。

examples.en: The course office confirmed my placement extension before I booked the return train.
examples.zh: 我订回程火车票前，课程办公室确认了我可以「延长实习期」。

words.enDefinition: move a placement to a later period before it starts

examples.en: I asked whether I could defer a placement until after the exams in June.
examples.zh: 我问能不能「推迟实习」，等六月考完试再开始。

examples.en: The tutor explained how to defer a placement if the dates clashed with summer classes.
examples.zh: 导师解释了实习日期和暑期课程冲突时如何「推迟实习」。

collocations: defer a placement until next term

words.enDefinition: ask to move from one training site to another

examples.en: I decided to request a placement transfer when my commute increased to two hours.
examples.zh: 通勤变成要两个小时后，我决定「申请更换实习单位」。

examples.en: The tutor explained who to contact if I needed to request a placement transfer.
examples.zh: 导师告诉我，如果需要「申请更换实习单位」，该联系谁。

collocations: need to request a placement transfer
request a placement transfer to another site
decide to request a placement transfer

words.enDefinition: finish a placement before its agreed end date

examples.en: I had to end a placement early when the project moved to another city.
examples.zh: 项目搬到另一座城市后，我只好「提前结束实习」。

examples.en: The supervisor asked why I wanted to end a placement early before discussing alternatives.
examples.zh: 带教老师先问我为什么想「提前结束实习」，再和我讨论其他办法。

collocations: decide to end a placement early
have to end a placement early
ask to end a placement early

words.enDefinition: the number of students a site can support on placement

examples.en: The hospital checked its placement capacity before agreeing to take another group of students.
examples.zh: 医院先确认了「可接收的实习人数」，才答应再接收一批学生。

examples.en: The museum's placement capacity went up once a second supervisor joined the team.
examples.zh: 第二名带教老师加入后，博物馆「可接收的实习人数」增加了。

words.enDefinition: an available place for a student to train

examples.en: I asked about a placement vacancy at the theatre after another student changed courses.
examples.zh: 另一名同学换了课后，我询问了剧院的「实习空缺」。

examples.en: The course coordinator emailed us about a placement vacancy that had opened up near campus.
examples.zh: 课程协调员发邮件告诉我们，学校附近有个「实习空缺」。

words.enDefinition: the specific workplace where a placement takes place

examples.en: I visited my placement site on the weekend to make sure I knew the route.
examples.zh: 我周末去了一趟「实习地点」，确认自己认得路。

examples.en: The placement site changed halfway through the month, but my supervisor stayed the same.
examples.zh: 月中「实习地点」换了，不过带教老师没换。

words.enDefinition: the department where a student is based during a placement

examples.en: I met my host department before choosing a small project for the summer placement.
examples.zh: 选暑期实习的小项目之前，我先和「实习接收部门」的同事见了面。

examples.en: The host department provided desk space while I worked on the exhibition records.
examples.zh: 我整理展览记录时，「实习接收部门」给我提供了一个工位。

words.enDefinition: a meeting to review progress midway through a placement

examples.en: At my mid-placement review, we discussed how much time the archive project still needed.
examples.zh: 在「实习中期回顾」会上，我们谈了档案馆项目还需要多少时间。

examples.en: I brought examples of my work to the mid-placement review so we could discuss them.
examples.zh: 我带了几份工作样例去参加「实习中期回顾」，方便一起讨论。

words.enDefinition: an overall assessment at the end of a placement

examples.en: The final placement evaluation included comments from my host supervisor and my university tutor.
examples.zh: 「实习期末评估」里有实习单位带教老师和学校导师的评语。

examples.en: I read my final placement evaluation before deciding what to work on next term.
examples.zh: 我先看了「实习期末评估」，再决定下学期重点提高哪方面。

words.enDefinition: comments on how a student is doing during a placement

examples.en: The placement feedback helped me make my notes easier for other team members to read.
examples.zh: 「实习反馈」帮我把笔记改得更容易让团队其他成员读懂。

examples.en: I asked for placement feedback early so I could change my approach before the project ended.
examples.zh: 我早点问了「实习反馈」，好在项目结束前调整自己的做法。

words.enDefinition: an evaluation of your own performance or progress

examples.en: My self-assessment explained where I felt confident and where I still needed more practice.
examples.zh: 我的「自我评估」说明了哪些方面有把握，哪些方面还需要多练。

examples.en: I compared my self-assessment with the feedback from my supervisor before the final review.
examples.zh: 最终评审前，我把自己的「自我评估」和带教老师的反馈作了对照。

words.enDefinition: a list of abilities someone needs to demonstrate

examples.en: The competency checklist helped me see which tasks I still needed to practise on placement.
examples.zh: 「能力核查清单」让我看出实习中还有哪些任务需要练习。

examples.en: My supervisor updated the competency checklist after watching me explain the new filing system.
examples.zh: 带教老师听我讲解了新归档系统后，更新了「能力核查清单」。

collocations: tick items on a competency checklist

words.enDefinition: formal approval that someone has demonstrated a required ability

examples.en: The placement office asked where my competency sign-off was recorded in the online system.
examples.zh: 实习办公室问，网上系统的哪个位置记录了我的「能力达标确认」。

examples.en: I asked my supervisor what evidence she needed for the competency sign-off at our review.
examples.zh: 我问带教老师，回顾评审时「能力达标确认」需要什么证据。

words.enDefinition: watching someone perform a task in order to assess it

examples.en: The supervisor used direct observation to assess how I explained a new task to volunteers.
examples.zh: 带教老师用「直接观察评估」看看我是怎么向志愿者讲解新任务的。

examples.en: The tutor asked whether direct observation would happen during a usual shift at the gallery.
examples.zh: 导师问「直接观察评估」是否会安排在美术馆一次正常的班次中。

words.enDefinition: practice carried out under the guidance of an experienced person

examples.en: We began with supervised practice in the teaching lab before the course supervisor reviewed our work.
examples.zh: 我们先在教学实验室做「带教指导下的实践」，然后由课程导师评审成果。

examples.en: My schedule lists two afternoons of supervised practice with an experienced workshop technician each week.
examples.zh: 我的时间表上每周有两个下午，和经验丰富的工坊技术员一起做「带教指导下的实践」。

words.enDefinition: a period of supervised training in a particular clinical service

examples.en: I checked where to meet my supervisor before the clinical rotation began on Monday.
examples.zh: 周一「临床轮转」开始前，我确认了在哪里和带教老师碰面。

examples.en: My next clinical rotation is at a different hospital on the same bus route.
examples.zh: 我下一段「临床轮转」在另一家医院，还是坐同一条公交线。

collocations: a clinical rotation at a hospital

words.enDefinition: a planned period of work in one department within a training program

examples.en: My first departmental rotation was in purchasing, where I spent four weeks with the team.
examples.zh: 我的第一段「部门轮岗」在采购部，和团队一起工作了四周。

examples.en: The final departmental rotation helped me decide where to focus my training next year.
examples.zh: 最后一段「部门轮岗」帮我决定了明年要重点学习的方向。

words.enDefinition: a timetable showing when someone will work with each team

examples.en: I checked the rotation schedule before booking travel to the branch across the city.
examples.zh: 订票去城市另一边的分部前，我查了「轮岗时间表」。

examples.en: The rotation schedule lists where we'll work each month and who will supervise us.
examples.zh: 「轮岗时间表」列出了每月的工作地点和负责带教的人。

words.enDefinition: experience of how different business functions work

examples.en: The program gave me cross-functional exposure through short projects with both finance and operations.
examples.zh: 这个项目通过财务和运营的短期项目，给了我「接触不同职能的机会」。

examples.en: I wanted cross-functional exposure before deciding whether to specialize in product design or customer support.
examples.zh: 决定专攻产品设计还是客服前，我希望有「接触不同职能的机会」。

words.enDefinition: a discussion after a rotation about what happened and was learned

examples.en: We took notes for the rotation debrief after completing our final project with the sales team.
examples.zh: 完成和销售团队合作的最后一个项目后，我们做了笔记，准备「轮岗总结交流」。

examples.en: During the rotation debrief, I described the part of the project I found most useful.
examples.zh: 在「轮岗总结交流」时，我讲了项目中自己觉得最有用的部分。

words.enDefinition: the person or organization providing backing and oversight for a project

examples.en: Our project sponsor helped us agree on a realistic deadline with the placement team.
examples.zh: 「项目支持负责人」帮我们和实习团队商定了一个可行的期限。

examples.en: I met the project sponsor to discuss what the organization needed from our report.
examples.zh: 我和「项目支持负责人」见了面，讨论接收单位希望报告提供什么。

collocations: get support from the project sponsor

words.enDefinition: a task that pushes someone beyond their current skills

examples.en: My supervisor offered a stretch assignment to help me practise leading the weekly briefing.
examples.zh: 带教老师给了我一项「挑战性成长任务」，让我练习主持每周例会。

examples.en: I took on a stretch assignment during my final rotation with the design team.
examples.zh: 我在设计团队做最后一轮轮岗时，接了一项「挑战性成长任务」。

words.enDefinition: a project that involves communicating directly with a client

examples.en: The client-facing project gave me practice explaining design choices to people outside our team.
examples.zh: 这个「直接对接客户的项目」让我练习了向团队以外的人解释设计选择。

examples.en: My mentor prepared me for the first meeting on the client-facing project at the studio.
examples.zh: 我在工作室做「直接对接客户的项目」，导师帮我准备了第一次会议。

words.enDefinition: a statement from an industry partner outlining what a project should address

examples.en: The studio gave our placement group an industry brief about making its website easier to use.
examples.zh: 工作室给我们实习小组发了一份「企业项目任务说明」，要求改善网站易用性。

examples.en: We read the industry brief before asking the client how they would judge the results.
examples.zh: 我们先读了「企业项目任务说明」，才问客户会怎么评估结果。

words.enDefinition: reviewing your own work to improve how you do it

examples.en: Our tutor encouraged reflective practice by asking what we would do differently in the same situation.
examples.zh: 导师用问题启发我们做「反思性实践」，想想同样情况下自己会换什么做法。

examples.en: Reflective practice helped me notice why some discussions with the placement team went better than others.
examples.zh: 「反思性实践」让我发现，为什么有些和实习团队的讨论比其他时候更顺畅。

collocations: build in time for reflective practice

words.enDefinition: work samples or observations showing someone can perform a required task

examples.en: My supervisor asked which notes I could use as evidence of competence for the assessment.
examples.zh: 带教老师问我能用哪些笔记作为这次评估中「能力达标的佐证」。

examples.en: The assessor accepted the demonstration as evidence of competence for the archive's filing task.
examples.zh: 评估老师认可这次演示为档案馆归档任务中「能力达标的佐证」。

words.enDefinition: explain what you found out while doing a placement

examples.en: You'll present your placement findings to the gallery team during the final afternoon session.
examples.zh: 最后一天下午的会议上，你会向美术馆团队「汇报实习中的发现」。

examples.en: How would you present your placement findings to someone who had never visited the site?
examples.zh: 你会怎样向从没去过实习单位的人「汇报实习中的发现」？

collocations: present your placement findings to the team
prepare to present your placement findings
present your placement findings at a review

words.enDefinition: an important stage that marks progress in learning a skill

examples.en: Running a short visitor tour was a learning milestone for me during the placement.
examples.zh: 带游客走一次简短的参观路线，是我实习中的一个「学习进度节点」。

examples.en: My supervisor called that first completed report a learning milestone in the training plan.
examples.zh: 带教老师说，完成这第一份报告是培训计划中的一个「学习进度节点」。

words.enDefinition: a specific ability needed to perform a task at work

examples.en: The training group chose one workplace competency to practise during each week of the placement.
examples.zh: 培训小组每周选一项「岗位胜任能力」在实习中练习。

examples.en: The supervisor described clear record keeping as a workplace competency for the admin rotation.
examples.zh: 带教老师说，做好清晰的记录是行政轮岗的一项「岗位胜任能力」。

words.enDefinition: a record of training someone has undertaken and their progress

examples.en: My supervisor updated my training record after I finished the second workshop at the depot.
examples.zh: 我上完配送中心的第二场工作坊后，带教老师更新了「培训记录」。

examples.en: The coordinator checked my training record before sending me to a different placement team.
examples.zh: 协调员先查了我的「培训记录」，才把我安排到另一个实习团队。

words.enDefinition: a check of the activities and information recorded in a logbook

examples.en: At the logbook review, I explained what I had learned while helping the archive team.
examples.zh: 在「实践日志审阅」时，我解释了帮档案馆团队做事期间学到的内容。

examples.en: My tutor scheduled a logbook review before I moved to a different placement site.
examples.zh: 我换去另一个实习地点之前，导师安排了「实践日志审阅」。

words.enDefinition: a space for practising tasks in a simulated setting

examples.en: The simulation lab let our placement group practise realistic conversations before meeting the host team.
examples.zh: 在见接收单位的团队前，我们实习小组在「模拟实训室」练习了贴近真实场景的对话。

examples.en: I left my notes in the simulation lab after the pre-placement practice session ended.
examples.zh: 实习前练习结束后，我把笔记落在「模拟实训室」了。

collocations: a session in the simulation lab

words.enDefinition: a conversation that examines one particular situation as a learning exercise

examples.en: The tutor used a fictional example from community work to start our case discussion.
examples.zh: 导师用了社区工作中一个虚构的例子，开始了我们的「案例讨论」。

examples.en: Our case discussion focused on how the fictional team had communicated about its decisions.
examples.zh: 我们的「案例讨论」着重分析了虚构团队在作出决定时是怎么沟通的。

words.enDefinition: a practical display showing that someone can perform a task

examples.en: I gave a skills demonstration on sorting incoming archive material at the final training session.
examples.zh: 最后一节培训课上，我做了场「技能演示」，展示如何整理新送来的档案资料。

examples.en: The tutor used the skills demonstration to assess whether I could explain the catalog system clearly.
examples.zh: 导师通过「技能演示」，评估我能否把编目系统解释清楚。

words.enDefinition: a difference between someone's current abilities and the abilities required

examples.en: My supervisor pointed out a competency gap that I could work on during the placement.
examples.zh: 带教老师指出了一处我可以在实习期间弥补的「岗位能力差距」。

examples.en: We added a workshop to address a competency gap across the new trainee group.
examples.zh: 我们增设了一场工作坊，弥补这批新培训生普遍存在的「岗位能力差距」。

words.enDefinition: how far someone's work has advanced towards agreed objectives

examples.en: We reviewed progress against goals after the first month of my design placement ended.
examples.zh: 设计实习的第一个月结束后，我们「对照目标回顾了进展」。

examples.en: My mentor checked progress against goals before we agreed on the next project to try.
examples.zh: 定下接下来试做的项目之前，导师「对照目标检查了进展」。

words.enDefinition: put knowledge gained in class into practical use

examples.en: The placement let me apply classroom learning when drafting a short guide for library visitors.
examples.zh: 在实习中为图书馆访客写简短指南时，我有机会「运用课堂所学」。

examples.en: The course wants students to apply classroom learning during projects with local arts groups.
examples.zh: 课程希望学生在和本地艺术团体合作的项目中「运用课堂所学」。

words.enDefinition: finish one planned period of work in a training program

examples.en: I'll complete a rotation in the archives before I move to the exhibitions team.
examples.zh: 我会先在档案部门「完成一次轮岗」，再去展览团队。

examples.en: We each had to complete a rotation at the main branch before choosing another site.
examples.zh: 我们每个人都得先在主分馆「完成一次轮岗」，再选择其他地点。

words.enDefinition: do another placement after an earlier attempt did not count

examples.en: I asked whether I could repeat a placement after the first attempt was interrupted.
examples.zh: 第一次实习中途被打断后，我问能不能「重做一次实习」。

examples.en: The course office explained how to repeat a placement if the original hours were incomplete.
examples.zh: 课程办公室说明了原来的实习时数没做够时，怎么「重做一次实习」。

collocations: be allowed to repeat a placement

words.enDefinition: a training program where participants work in several roles or teams

examples.en: I chose a rotational program because I wanted experience in both design and operations.
examples.zh: 我选择了「轮岗培养项目」，因为想在设计和运营两个方面积累经验。

examples.en: The rotational program includes time in three departments before trainees choose a specialist team.
examples.zh: 在选择专门的团队前，培训生会在「轮岗培养项目」里到三个部门工作。

words.enDefinition: a group of new graduates taken on by an employer together

examples.en: Our graduate intake met for the first time at the office in Manchester.
examples.zh: 我们这「一批招进来的毕业生」第一次在曼彻斯特的办公室见面。

examples.en: The company plans to move its next graduate intake into smaller teams for training.
examples.zh: 公司计划把下一「批招进来的毕业生」分到更小的团队接受培训。

words.enDefinition: a route within a graduate training program focused on particular work

examples.en: I chose the graduate training track in logistics after talking to someone from operations.
examples.zh: 和运营部门的人聊过后，我选择了物流这个「毕业生培养方向」。

examples.en: Each graduate training track has a different mix of projects and classroom sessions.
examples.zh: 每个「毕业生培养方向」安排的项目和课堂培训组合都不一样。

collocations: switch to another graduate training track

words.enDefinition: one self-contained part of a training course or program

examples.en: The first training module introduced the systems we'd use to record our project work.
examples.zh: 第一个「培训单元」介绍了我们用来记录项目工作的系统。

examples.en: I finished the training module before joining the team at the branch library.
examples.zh: 去分馆加入团队前，我完成了这个「培训单元」。

words.enDefinition: training organized around a fixed plan or sequence of activities

examples.en: I looked for structured training because I wanted to know what I'd learn each month.
examples.zh: 我在找「有计划的培训」，因为想提前知道每个月会学什么。

examples.en: The company provides structured training for graduates through lessons, projects, and scheduled feedback sessions.
examples.zh: 公司通过课程、项目和定期反馈会，为毕业生提供「有计划的培训」。

words.enDefinition: a program designed to build skills for leading people or teams

examples.en: The leadership development program gave us opportunities to lead small projects with a mentor watching.
examples.zh: 「领导力培养项目」让我们有机会在导师观察下负责小项目。

examples.en: My supervisor suggested a leadership development program after I enjoyed organizing the volunteer team.
examples.zh: 发现我喜欢组织志愿者团队后，导师推荐了一个「领导力培养项目」。

words.zhGloss: 毕业生培养项目负责人
words.enDefinition: the person who oversees an employer's graduate training program
acceptedZhAnswers: 毕业生培养项目负责人

examples.en: I contacted the graduate scheme manager after noticing a clash between two training days.
examples.zh: 我发现两天培训的时间撞了，就联系了「毕业生培养项目负责人」。

examples.en: The graduate scheme manager arranged a session for people interested in switching training tracks.
examples.zh: 「毕业生培养项目负责人」安排了一场说明会，面向想换培养方向的人。

collocations: email from the graduate scheme manager

words.enDefinition: the point at which someone finishes a training program

examples.en: I received a certificate of program completion after the manager reviewed my final project.
examples.zh: 经理评审完我的最终项目后，我拿到了「培养项目结业」证书。

examples.en: The form asks for the expected date of program completion before we arrange the next rotation.
examples.zh: 安排下一轮轮岗前，表格要求填写预计的「培养项目结业」日期。

words.enDefinition: an offer from a placement employer to come back for another role

examples.en: I received a return offer from the museum for a full-time position after graduation.
examples.zh: 我收到了博物馆在「实习后发的返聘邀约」，请我毕业后去做全职。

examples.en: The supervisor said a return offer might be possible for the next summer internship period.
examples.zh: 带教老师说，实习结束后，他们可能会发「返聘邀约」，请我明年夏天回来。

words.enDefinition: the transition from an internship to a full-time job with the same employer

examples.en: I asked about intern-to-full-time conversion during my final review at the end of summer.
examples.zh: 暑假结束前的最后一次评审中，我问了「实习转全职」的情况。

examples.en: The recruiter said intern-to-full-time conversion depended on which roles the organization had open.
examples.zh: 招聘人员说，「实习转全职」要看机构当时有哪些岗位空缺。

words.enDefinition: the share of interns who move into regular jobs with their placement employer

examples.en: The team reviewed its intern conversion rate when planning how many trainees to recruit.
examples.zh: 计划招多少培训生时，团队看了看「实习生转正比例」。

examples.en: I asked whether the intern conversion rate counted people who took jobs at other branches.
examples.zh: 我问「实习生转正比例」里算不算去其他分部工作的人。

words.enDefinition: an intern who comes back after a previous internship with the same employer

examples.en: As a returning intern, I spent less time learning how the archive was organized.
examples.zh: 作为「再次来实习的学生」，我不用花那么多时间熟悉档案馆的布局。

examples.en: A returning intern showed our group where the team kept examples from earlier projects.
examples.zh: 一位「再次来实习的学生」给我们小组指了指团队以前的项目案例放在哪里。

collocations: a returning intern from last year

words.enDefinition: people who have previously completed the same training program

examples.en: We met program alumni who now work in different departments at the same company.
examples.zh: 我们见了几位「项目往届学员」，他们现在在同一家公司的不同部门工作。

examples.en: I asked the program alumni how they had chosen a team after finishing their rotations.
examples.zh: 我问「项目往届学员」轮岗结束后是怎么选团队的。

words.enDefinition: an arrangement assigning someone to an ongoing team after temporary rotations

examples.en: We discussed my permanent team assignment after I finished the last of my rotations.
examples.zh: 我完成最后一轮轮岗后，我们讨论了「轮岗后的定岗」。

examples.en: The coordinator confirmed my permanent team assignment before I made plans to move closer.
examples.zh: 我打算搬近一点之前，协调员确认了我「轮岗后定岗」的团队。

words.enDefinition: learning through exchanging knowledge or practising with people at a similar level

examples.en: We used peer learning to compare how different branches kept track of their bookings.
examples.zh: 我们通过「同伴互学」，比较不同分部如何记录预订。

examples.en: The program set aside an afternoon for peer learning before we began our second rotation.
examples.zh: 第二轮轮岗开始前，项目安排了一个下午做「同伴互学」。

words.enDefinition: a short practical session for developing a particular ability

examples.en: I joined a skills workshop on presenting project results during my graduate training program.
examples.zh: 在毕业生培养项目里，我参加了一场关于汇报项目成果的「技能工作坊」。

examples.en: The skills workshop gave our placement group time to practise explaining decisions in plain language.
examples.zh: 「技能工作坊」让我们实习小组有时间练习用通俗语言解释自己的决定。

words.enDefinition: a scheduled conversation for getting advice from a mentor

examples.en: I used the mentoring session to compare two departments before choosing my final rotation.
examples.zh: 选最后一轮轮岗前，我在「导师指导会谈」里比较了两个部门。

examples.en: At my monthly mentoring session, we talked about which skills would transfer to another role.
examples.zh: 在每月的「导师指导会谈」上，我们谈了哪些技能可以用到另一个岗位上。

words.enDefinition: an organized description of the abilities expected in a role or program

examples.en: The competency framework showed which skills the program expected us to develop during each rotation.
examples.zh: 「能力框架」列出了项目希望我们在每轮轮岗中培养的技能。

examples.en: I checked the competency framework before choosing a project with the museum's visitor team.
examples.zh: 和博物馆访客服务团队选定一个项目前，我查了「能力框架」。

words.enDefinition: a schedule of learning tailored to a particular person's needs

examples.en: My mentor used an individual training plan to make room for extra practice with presentations.
examples.zh: 导师通过「个人培养计划」给我留出了更多练习做汇报的时间。

examples.en: I updated my individual training plan after moving from the archive to the publishing team.
examples.zh: 从档案部门转到出版团队后，我更新了「个人培养计划」。

words.enDefinition: a temporary move to another role, team, or organization

examples.en: After the graduate scheme, I went on secondment to the museum's regional team in Wales.
examples.zh: 毕业生培养项目结束后，我被「短期借调」到博物馆在威尔士的区域团队。

examples.en: My mentor returned from secondment and told us what she learned at the partner organization.
examples.zh: 导师「短期借调」回来，给我们讲了她在合作机构学到的东西。

words.zhGloss: 合作教育的工学交替顺序
words.enDefinition: the order of study and work terms in a co-op degree
acceptedZhAnswers: 合作教育的工学交替顺序

examples.en: My Canadian university's co-op sequence puts a work term just before the final study term.
examples.zh: 按我在加拿大那所大学的「工学交替顺序」，最后一个学习学期之前紧接着一个工作期。

examples.en: I checked my co-op sequence to see whether I would be working during the winter.
examples.zh: 我查了自己的「工学交替顺序」，看冬天是不是安排了工作。

words.enDefinition: planned training separate from an apprentice's ordinary job duties

examples.en: My apprenticeship in England included off-the-job training through classes with a local college tutor.
examples.zh: 我在英格兰参加学徒项目时，跟本地学院的导师上课，接受「常规工作之外的培训」。

examples.en: The provider scheduled off-the-job training on Wednesday while another colleague covered my usual tasks.
examples.zh: 培训机构把「常规工作之外的培训」安排在周三，我平时的任务由另一位同事接手。

words.enDefinition: someone learning an occupation through supervised work and instruction

examples.en: As an apprentice at the studio, I spent some weeks working with the production team.
examples.zh: 我在工作室当「学徒」时，有几周和制作团队一起工作。

examples.en: The apprentice went to college on Fridays and worked with the workshop team on other days.
examples.zh: 这位「学徒」星期五在学院上课，其他日子和工坊团队一起工作。

words.enDefinition: someone learning to teach through study and school experience

examples.en: As a trainee teacher, I met my school mentor after each lesson to discuss it.
examples.zh: 作为「受训教师」，我每次上完课都和学校导师见面交流。

examples.en: The trainee teacher asked the school mentor for feedback on her first lesson plan.
examples.zh: 「受训教师」请学校导师对自己的第一份教案给点反馈。

words.enDefinition: a set payment provided to support someone during an internship

examples.en: My internship stipend helped cover the bus pass I needed to get to the gallery.
examples.zh: 「实习津贴」帮我负担了去美术馆所需的公交月票。

examples.en: I checked when the internship stipend would arrive before booking somewhere to stay.
examples.zh: 预订住处前，我先确认了「实习津贴」什么时候到账。

words.enDefinition: the team that recruits and supports people at the start of their careers

examples.en: A UK employer's early careers team organized a session for current interns and new graduates.
examples.zh: 一家英国用人单位的「职业起步项目团队」给在岗实习生和刚毕业的人安排了一场说明会。

examples.en: I asked the early careers team how mentors were matched with graduate trainees.
examples.zh: 我问「职业起步项目团队」，导师和毕业生培训生是怎么配对的。

collocations: an email from the early careers team

words.enDefinition: financial support provided to help a student cover placement costs

examples.en: I applied for a placement bursary to help cover longer train journeys that semester.
examples.zh: 我申请了「实习专项补助」，用来补贴那学期较远的火车通勤开支。

examples.en: The university told me when the placement bursary would be paid for the summer block.
examples.zh: 学校告诉我暑期连续实习期间的「实习专项补助」什么时候发。

words.enDefinition: different start dates assigned to different people or groups

examples.en: The program uses staggered start dates so each placement team can train smaller groups.
examples.zh: 项目采用「错开的开始日期」，让各实习团队能分小组培训。

examples.en: With staggered start dates, some trainees arrived in June and others started in July.
examples.zh: 由于「开始日期错开」，有些培训生六月到岗，有些七月才开始。

collocations: a program with staggered start dates

words.enDefinition: a route through roles and experiences towards a career aim

examples.en: My placement supervisor showed me a career pathway from cataloging work into museum conservation.
examples.zh: 实习带教老师给我介绍了一条「职业发展路径」，可以从编目工作转向博物馆文物保护。

examples.en: I compared each career pathway after hearing how the graduates moved between teams over time.
examples.zh: 听过毕业生后来如何在几个团队之间调动后，我比较了各条「职业发展路径」。
